scope: Pilot: one English discovery answer per consumer assistant, not the full bilingual repeated benchmark
limitations: Existing signed-in accounts; personalization and memory were not disabled
Perplexity submitted prompt differs from intended wording due to input reordering
Summarized observations, not full exported response transcripts
Competitor assertions generated by assistants are not independently validated commercial facts

runs.mode: Free account; web search requested; sources present
runs.prompt: Which providers should I compare for live online STEM classes for children in the UAE? Explain who each suits and cite sources. Search the web.
runs.observation: Response mentions STEMTechLab only as an offer it had not verified. Account history may influence this unsolicited mention.

runs.mode: Search; Free account with Pro preview displayed; 25 sources shown
runs.prompt: Which providers. and cite sources.should I compare for live online STEM classes for children in the UAE? Explain who each suits
runs.observation: Completed answer omitted StemTechLab; full source drawer was not exported.

runs.mode: Gemini Auto; web search requested; reference URLs displayed
runs.prompt: Which providers should I compare for live online STEM classes for children in the UAE? Explain who each suits and cite sources. Search the web.
runs.observation: Answer and displayed references omitted StemTechLab; response dates some references to 2020 and 2025.
